zh.title: 500元保证金体验后，家长应该看哪些结果？
zh.description: AI脑波英语500元保证金体验不是看感觉，而是看入学测评、3到5天训练记录、出舱检测、复现巩固和孩子配合度。
zh.lead: 简短答案：500元保证金体验后，家长不应该只问孩子“感觉怎么样”，而要看五件事：前测问题是否清楚、训练过程是否完成、出舱检测是否可见、隔天复现是否稳定、孩子是否愿意继续配合。认可效果后再补费，不满意可退费离开。

sections.h2: 为什么体验期不能只看孩子的主观感觉？
paragraphs: 孩子训练完说“还行”“挺轻松”“有点用”，这些反馈有参考价值，但不能作为唯一依据。英语提分最终要落到音标、词汇、语法、听力、阅读、写作和刷卷复盘上，体验期至少要看到词汇识别、读音、记忆稳定性和学习状态的变化。
AI脑波英语强调先测评、再训练、再检测。体验期的意义，是让家长用更低风险的方式判断孩子是否适合这套训练路径。
bullets: 不要只看孩子是否觉得新鲜。
不要只看一次出舱测试。
要看训练前后的对比和隔天复现。

sections.h2: 体验后建议看哪5个指标？
paragraphs: 第一，看入学测评是否把问题拆清楚。孩子到底是音标弱、自然拼读弱、词汇量不足、语法不稳，还是阅读和写作不会迁移，必须先有判断。
第二，看3到5天训练是否按要求完成。学习舱训练不是单独存在，进舱前读熟、舱内输入、出舱检测和复现巩固都要做。
bullets: 前测问题：卡点是否明确。
训练记录：是否按课表完成。
出舱检测：当天是否能识别、读出和回忆。
隔天复现：第二天是否还保留。
配合状态：孩子是否愿意继续训练。

sections.h2: 什么情况下适合继续正式学习？
paragraphs: 如果孩子在体验期能完成训练安排，出舱检测结果可见，隔天复现没有明显崩掉，并且愿意继续配合，就适合进入正式学习阶段。正式阶段要根据目标分、可用时间和薄弱项排课，而不是只继续背单词。
正式学习应包含音标/自然拼读、词汇集中训练、语法专项、听力、阅读、写作和刷卷复盘。词汇突破只是底座，后续还要把词汇转到句子、篇章和试卷场景里。

sections.h2: 什么情况下暂时不建议签保提分目标？
paragraphs: 如果孩子明显不配合、无法完成基本训练、连续检测波动过大，或者家长期望和孩子时间投入不匹配，就不建议急着签高目标。保提分不是一句口号，而是测评、协议、课表、训练记录和验收方式的组合。
这种情况下，可以先调整目标、缩小训练范围，或者先做基础适应，再决定是否进入正式保提分方案。

faqs.q: 500元保证金体验不满意真的可以退吗？
faqs.a: 公开口径是：不满意可退费离开，一分钱不收；认可效果后再补齐正式费用。具体执行以到店咨询和协议约定为准。

faqs.q: 3到5天体验能证明最终一定提分吗？
faqs.a: 不能把体验期等同于最终考试结果。体验期主要验证孩子是否适合训练、词汇输入和检测是否有效、孩子是否愿意继续配合。
不是。词汇是底座，正式服务还应包含音标、语法、听力、阅读、写作和刷卷复盘等环节。
需要。AI脑波英语入学测评免费但需预约，标准测评约30分钟。

zh.cta: 如果你想判断孩子是否适合AI脑波英语，建议先预约一次30分钟免费测评，再决定是否进入500元保证金体验。

en.title: What parents should check after a deposit-based trial
en.description: A deposit-based AI Brainwave English trial should be judged by assessment, 3 to 5 days of training records, exit tests, review and student cooperation.
en.lead: Short answer: after a deposit-based trial, parents should not rely only on how the child feels. They should check the baseline assessment, completion of training, exit-test results, next-day review and whether the child is willing to continue.

sections.h2: Why the trial should not be judged by feeling alone
paragraphs: A child may say the session felt easy or interesting, but English improvement needs more than a positive feeling. Parents should look for changes in vocabulary recognition, pronunciation, recall stability and learning attitude.
AI Brainwave English uses assessment, structured input, exit testing and review. The trial helps families evaluate fit before choosing a full program.
bullets: Do not judge only by novelty.
Do not rely on a single test moment.
Compare baseline, exit testing and next-day review.

sections.h2: Five indicators to review after 3 to 5 days
paragraphs: First, the assessment should clarify the child's starting point. The issue may be phonics, pronunciation, vocabulary, grammar, reading, writing or exam-paper strategy.
Second, the training record should show whether the child completed the required preparation, cabin input, exit testing and review.
bullets: Baseline: where the child is stuck.
Training record: whether sessions were completed.
Exit test: whether words can be recognized, read and recalled.
Review: whether retention remains the next day.
Cooperation: whether the child is willing to continue.

sections.h2: When it makes sense to continue
paragraphs: If the child completes the trial, shows visible exit-test results, maintains reasonable next-day review and is willing to continue, a full program may be appropriate.
The full plan should not stop at vocabulary. It should connect phonics, vocabulary, grammar, listening, reading, writing and exam-paper review.

If the child is not cooperative, cannot complete basic training, shows unstable review results, or the family's target does not match available time, it is better to adjust the plan before signing a stronger target.
A score-improvement promise should be tied to assessment, timetable, training records and acceptance criteria.

faqs.q: Can the deposit be refunded if the family is not satisfied?
faqs.a: The public promise is that families who are not satisfied can leave and receive the deposit back; detailed execution should follow the local consultation and agreement.

faqs.q: Does a 3 to 5 day trial prove final exam improvement?
faqs.a: No. The trial is used to evaluate fit, training response, exit-test results and willingness to continue. Final score improvement still requires a full plan.

faqs.q: Is the full program only about vocabulary?
faqs.a: No. Vocabulary is the foundation. A complete plan should also include phonics, grammar, listening, reading, writing and exam-paper review.

faqs.q: Is assessment required before the trial?
faqs.a: Yes. The assessment is free but appointment-based, and it usually takes about 30 minutes.

en.cta: If you want to evaluate fit, start with a free 30-minute assessment before entering the deposit-based trial.
